newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CONTE TO HAVE KNEE OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CONTE TO HAVE KNEE OPERATION.

text.p: Italy midfielder Antonio Conte will undergo knee surgery on Saturday which will sideline him for at least six months.
Juventus team doctor Riccardo Agricola said on Friday Conte would have surgery on cruciate ligaments in his left knee. He injured the knee in Italy's World Cup qualifying win over Georgia last month.
Juventus officials had recently said Conte was not expected to need surgery but Agricola said they had been too optimistic.
It was the second major blow this season for the aggressive midfielder who helped Juventus win the European Cup last May.
He missed the European championship finals in England because of injury.
